description: Test fixture module for plugin loader in openclaw project, providing utility functions for creating temporary directories, writing plugins, loading plugin bundles, and resetting test state.

methods.name: chmodSafeDir
methods.description: Sets directory permissions to 755 on non-Windows platforms.

methods.name: mkdtempSafe
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with safe permissions.

methods.name: mkdirSafe
methods.description: Creates a directory recursively with safe permissions.

methods.name: makeTempDir
methods.description: Creates a new temporary directory for test fixtures.

methods.name: writePlugin
methods.description: Writes a plugin file and its JSON manifest to disk, returning plugin info.

methods.name: useNoBundledPlugins
methods.description: Sets environment variable to disable bundled plugins.

methods.name: loadBundleFixture
methods.description: Sets up and loads a plugin bundle fixture for testing.

methods.name: resetPluginLoaderTestStateForTest
methods.description: Resets plugin loader test state and caches.

methods.name: cleanupPluginLoaderFixturesForTest
methods.description: Removes temporary fixture directories used in tests.
